notes: THE TENTH ACTION VERB IS A QUESTION, AND A BLOCKING QUESTION HOLDS THE TRADE. Until this release the rule vocabulary had nine verbs and no way to ask: a rule that wanted a human decision mid-firing had notify — a sentence in an inbox with nothing attached to decide — so every automated proposal was either booked or refused with no rung between. escalate {question, blocking?, deadline?} is the missing middle and it is LAW C made mechanical: the harness proposes, the owner rules. - Non-blocking, it is a typed ask: a first-class escalation inbox kind (the 5.8.0 rule — never relabelled system) car
